# Mani Verdi Management System

A modern, multilingual (Arabic, English, Italian) web management application for Mani Verdi company.

## Project Requirements
- Frontend: React with modern UI
- Backend: Node.js with Express
- Database: MongoDB
- Languages: Arabic, English, Italian
- Features:
  - Login system (admin/admin, superuser iraq/iraq, normal user mani/mani)
  - Dashboard with modern icons
  - Modules: Imports, Exports, Notes, Employees
  - User management (superuser only)
  - Search functionality
  - Automatic sum calculations
  - Edit/Delete capabilities
  - Product name field for imports/exports
  - Responsive design

## Tech Stack
- React.js (Frontend)
- Node.js + Express (Backend)
- MongoDB (Database)
- Material-UI or similar for modern design
- i18next for internationalization
